name: pro.hostboost/hostboost
description: Airbnb listing optimization knowledge and audit reports. Query guides or order a scored PDF audit.

tools.name: get_report_offer
tools.description: Read the current price, coverage, delivery time and refund terms for a HostBoost Airbnb listing audit.

tools.name: start_listing_report
tools.description: Return a prefilled HostBoost order link for a public Airbnb listing. Does not create a report, charge the user, or navigate their browser. Use when the user wants a paid listing-specific audit.

airbnb_url.description: Public Airbnb listing URL, such as https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/12345

language.description: Preferred checkout and report language. Defaults to en.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search HostBoost guides about Airbnb photo order, titles, pricing, ranking, reviews and badges, plus report coverage and methodology. Choose the user's preferred language; default is English. Returns up to five documents with canonical citation URLs; use fetch to read them.

language.description: Document language: en, es, fr, de, it, pt or nl. Defaults to en.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of one public document returned by search, with publisher, date, canonical URL and relevant report links. Accepts document IDs, never arbitrary URLs or customer report IDs.
